craftVillage.title: The Soul of Vietnamese Tea Heritage
craftVillage.subtitle: Preserving and celebrating Thang Long's traditional tea craft
craftVillage.intro: Thang Long Che Viet is rooted in time-honored tea villages — where every bud is tended by skilled artisans with deep love for their homeland.
craftVillage.body: We work directly with farming families and workshops in source regions, preserving hand-firing, lotus scenting and hygienic packaging standards. Each product tells a story of land, water and people — bringing the Vietnamese spirit to every cup.
